verses.verse:
वाद्येषु रुचिरं मन्ये बंशीवाद्यं सुसप्तकम्।
माधुर्यादल्प मूल्यत्वा ल्लघुत्वात् सर्वसंभवात्।।५।।
verses.text: Among instruments I consider the bānsurī, with its fine seven notes, the most pleasing: because of its sweetness, because it costs little, because it is light, and because it can be had everywhere.

commentary.text: Since this instrument is within easy reach of the poor and the rich alike, and can be found anywhere from the forest to the market, who would not love this simple and sweet instrument?

following.text: Here Begins the Section on Making
Although learned men hold many views about its origin, in this scientific age my view is different from all of them, and reasoned.
